Heure Dorée is a premium sardine brand inspired by the shifting light of the Mediterranean golden hour. Each variant is tied to aspecific timestamp, translating real sunset moments into a distinct color system and flavor experience.

Heure Dorée is a premium sardine brand inspired by the shifting light of the Mediterranean golden hour. Each variant is tied to aspecific timestamp, translating real sunset moments into a distinct color system and flavor experience.

I developed the brand concept, visual identity, and packaging system; combining expressive gradients, chrome-glass illustrations,and foil detailing to capture light as a core design element. The result is a cohesive brand that positions sardines as a time-based,sensory experience rather than just a pantry staple, designed to stand out in modern, design-conscious retail spaces.

Branding & Content Design for Love on Site

Love on Site is a digital product that offers modern, aesthetic wedding websites for Nigerian and diaspora couples. I designed the logo, color palette, and website templates from scratch. The brand blends romance and functionality, with soft colors, elegant typography, and mobile-friendly layouts. Each template is made for easy customization, helping couples share their story in style, without any design stress.

Jiffy Jollof is a ready-to-cook jollof rice blend sold in jars. I was hired to create branded social media graphics that better communicated the product’s value and use cases. The new visuals simplified the brand message and brought consistency to their content. The result? More engagement, clearer storytelling, and a scroll-worthy feed that reflected the product’s convenience and flavor.
Mobile & Motion Design for Gourmet Guide

Gourmet Guide is a mobile app that helps users discover curated food spots. I worked on the UI design and created motion graphics for onboarding and social media content. The visuals were designed to be clean, intuitive, and dynamic, helping users quickly understand how the app works while giving the brand a polished, tech-forward feel.

Rika Trips is a premium travel company offering accommodation, chauffeur, airport concierge, visa support, activities, and bespoke services I redesigned their website with a clean, modern interface and seamless booking flows to improve clarity and user experience.
